eval: document.getElementById('tab-streams').click(); document.querySelector('#seg-sync_mode button[data-index="0"]').click(); window.__giState = (name, sel, key, setup) => { window.__veOrig = window.__veOrig || window.__setLanguage; const nat = window.__stubOverrides.natives, tel = nat.getTelemetry; const c = { nat, tel, rec: (o) => { Object.assign(tel.rec, { bus: 1, signal: true, run: 0, slot: 0, pos: 0, len: 4, capped: false }, o || {}); tel.lanes.forEach((l, i) => { l.rec = tel.rec.run === 2 && tel.rec.slot === i + 1 ? tel.rec.pos : null; }); }, combo: (id, i) => window.__stubStates.combos.get(id).setChoiceIndex(i), drop: (n, items) => { const e = new Event('drop', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); Object.defineProperty(e, 'dataTransfer', { value: { items } }); document.getElementById('lane-' + n).dispatchEvent(e); } }; const go = async () => { await setup(c); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 150)); const el = document.querySelector(sel); if (!el) throw new Error(name + ': no node ' + sel); const cs = getComputedStyle(el), b = el.getBoundingClientRect(); if (cs.display === 'none' || cs.visibility === 'hidden' || cs.opacity === '0' || !(b.width > 0 && b.height > 0)) throw new Error(name + ': node not visible ' + sel); if (el.dataset.i18n !== key) throw new Error(name + ': ' + sel + ' shows ' + el.dataset.i18n + ', expected ' + key); }; window.__setLanguage = (l) => { const r = window.__veOrig(l); return go().then(() => r); }; return go(); }; window.__giState('rec-armed', '#rec-status-t', 'rec.armed', (c) => { c.combo('rec_trigger', 0); c.rec({ run: 1 }); });
